name: Defect register — fix one group
description: Started by the fix fan-out, once per approved group, in rank order: reproduces, makes the smallest fix with a unit test, verifies, and opens one PR against develop in the defect-register format. Runs one at a time, because fixes share the live stack.

parameters.name: stateDir
parameters.description: The pipeline's working folder, shared across its runs: backlog, triage verdicts, ranked.md, fixes.

parameters.name: productBase
parameters.description: The product branch fixes start from and PRs target.

parameters.name: testRepo
parameters.description: The Playwright repository with the failing specs.

parameters.name: testBranch
parameters.description: The test repository branch the register was built from.

parameters.name: faketimeFile
parameters.description: The live stack's libfaketime clock file (the tests' FAKETIME_FILE).
